analysis.session_summary: Overnight NY afternoon into Asia was a risk-off yen bid and broad USD-soft session: DXY lost -38.4 points (-0.388%) and closed at 0.04 of its range, while USD/JPY fell -81.1 pips (-0.526%). JPY was the strongest major at +0.448% vs majors and USD the weakest at -0.156%; Brent/USD rallied +1.619% on Kharg Island headlines. Most zigzag legs had no clear catalyst; only USD/CAD and USD/MXN showed medium-confidence headline reactions of +7.5 and +90.3 pips respectively to the Kharg headline. Calendar ahead is empty, leaving headline risk as the main driver.

polarity_reads.read: The measured headline legs were USD/CAD +7.5 pips and USD/MXN +90.3 pips over 45 min; that is a risk-off USD bid against CAD/MXN, not an inverted reaction.

polarity_reads.event: Trump: I am hereby authorizing GSA to remove Canadian-orgin products unless Canada restores full reciprocity for American farmers and companies

scenarios.name: JPY-led risk-off / USD soft continuation
scenarios.thesis: The session's dominant tape is broad USD softness and yen strength; DXY closed near its lows and USD/JPY fell 81.1 pips. Oil headlines favor carry unwind and keep JPY bid.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recovers the full -81.1 pip session decline and DXY reclaims 98.465.

pair_paths.rationale: Largest measured no-catalyst USD/JPY down leg was -65.8 pips; continuation with JPY strongest major.
Largest measured EUR/USD up leg was 9.6 pips and close_in_range was 0.95.
Last measured USD/CAD down leg was -13.0 pips; broad USD softness outweighs oil bid for CAD.
Largest measured AUD/USD up leg was 12.6 pips; AUD second strongest at +0.031%.
Largest measured USD/CHF down leg was -10.8 pips; CHF less strong but USD weak.

scenarios.name: De-escalation / tariff headline fade
scenarios.thesis: Kharg Island risk premium fades and the Trump Canada GSA headline fails to produce CAD downside; short-USD carry positions cover.
triggers: USD/MXN fades the +90.3 pip headline leg
Trump Canada tariff language does not escalate
scenarios.invalidation: Brent makes a new high above 100.87 and USD/CAD takes out 1.37729.

pair_paths.rationale: Largest measured USD/JPY up leg was +47.8 pips; candidate short-covering bounce.
Largest measured EUR/USD down leg was -7.9 pips; USD stabilizes.
The medium-confidence Kharg headline leg was +7.5 pips; re-pricing tariff risk.
Measured USD/MXN down leg was -106.6 pips; MXN recovers as headline risk fades.
Largest measured AUD/USD down leg was -12.5 pips; USD bounce.

scenarios.name: US-Canada trade escalation / broader risk-off
scenarios.thesis: Trump GSA tariff authorization becomes the marginal driver; CAD and MXN underperform while JPY and CHF attract safe-haven flows.
scenarios.invalidation: US-Canada trade headlines de-escalate and USD/CAD falls back below 1.37729.

Largest measured USD/CHF down leg was -10.8 pips; safe-haven CHF bid.

Bessent highlighted insight into BOJ and yen intervention; USD/JPY already -81.1 pips at 153.465.
Most zigzag legs had no clear catalyst and calendar_ahead is empty, so headline gaps are magnified.
